notes.title: Patch Notes – Version 0.015
notes.content:
Patch Notes – Version 0.015
Release Date: June 5, 2025

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the player could become unable to move under specific conditions

Resolved a bug causing AI characters to get stuck during navigation

Corrected minor localization errors across several languages

Improvements

Added subtle visual and environmental clues to improve overall flow

notes.title: Remorses Demo - Major Update
notes.content:
Patch notes:

-Major loading time issue fixed — loading now works as intended.

-Heavy optimization for improved performance.

-Clarified certain in-game texts for better understanding.
